messages:
Nora (CS): FYI — Acme renewal is on hold with procurement. They want to swap 10 seats from Prod -> Dev (no net seat change) and add +3 months to the term. They said procurement will route a PO late next week and are reluctant to use DocuSign for the PO itself. Need to decide provisioning + invoicing flow.
Sam (AE): Quick q — who is signing on their side? CFO or procurement agent? Also, do they need an amended SOW or just a PO amendment?
Priya (Finance): We have vendor code ACME-NA. Scanned/signed PDF PO is acceptable if it has PO number and signature. If PO arrives late we can do a provisional invoice but need clear payer entity and tax id. Billing won't be final until PO number received.
Leo (Legal): Legal ok with seat swap and the term adjustment. DocuSign preferred for the amendment, but we can accept signed PDFs as an exception — need signer name/title/email on record. We'll add language that billing starts on receipt of PO if they want to delay signature.
Nora (CS): Customer emailed a signed PDF from cfo@acme.com (signed J. Ramos) and said wet-signed PO possible next week. They want onboarding to start this week. Can we provision limited seats ahead of the PO?
Onboarding Bot: To proceed safely: we can create sandbox seats and schedule enablement, but limit production permissions until billing is confirmed.
Sam (AE): I'll push for a DocuSign link but if procurement refuses, we should agree on a limited provisioning approach. Can we carve out 10 dev seats with quota caps and no billing until PO clears?
Priya (Finance): We can do a manual exception: provision the dev seats with billing suspended and create a provisional invoice. Finance needs an email from their AP confirming PO number or "PO pending, will send by <date>" — that email will be the authorization.
Leo (Legal): I'll draft a short addendum/acknowledgment that accepts a scanned PO and sets billing start on PO receipt. Can someone confirm the invoice entity details so I can include them?
Nora (CS): Invoice entity: Acme Inc (US), EIN 12-3456789. AP contact is maria.lopez@acme.com — I'll get an email confirmation and post here for audit.
docbot (DocuSign): Reminder: DocuSign preserves audit trail and reduces billing disputes. Template: "Renewal Amendment v2" is ready to send if they agree.
Priya (Finance): If we proceed with provisional provisioning, I'll prepare the provisional invoice and add the note "Billing suspended pending PO #". We need the PO number to finalize accounting entries.
Sam (AE): Got it — I'll ping Maria now and ask for either PO# or confirmation that a scanned PDF is authorization. If no PO by Thu (enablement slot), propose starting sandbox enablement only.
Leo (Legal): Drafting addendum now, will share by EOD for quick sign-off. If they insist on wet-signature only, we'll accept but timeline shifts.
Nora (CS): Action items: Sam confirm PO/DocuSign, Priya ready provisional invoice & notes, Leo draft addendum, Onboarding prepare limited-access plan. I'll update when Maria replies.
Nora (CS): Update — Maria replied to my email: "We can send a scanned PO today (PO# ACME-7788) and will follow up with a wet-signed copy next week." I'll drop the PDF into our contract folder and tag finance.
Priya (Finance): Great — please forward the scanned PO to finance@redwood and include confirmation that invoice should be issued to "Acme Inc (US) EIN 12-3456789". Once we have PO# we can finalize billing start date and remove the provisional flag.
Sam (AE): Thanks team. I'll confirm with onboarding that sandbox enablement can go ahead Thursday and escalate if they insist on full prod access.
Nora (CS): Closing loop: onboarding scheduled for Thu (sandbox). Priya will issue provisional invoice once PO copied to finance. Leo will circulate addendum draft. I'll keep thread updated. :thumbsup:
